egin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5.7

Prove the preceding corollary. \end{exercise}
Proof

We will show that $ abla ^{ op }$ satisfies (5.1). Suppose $X, Y, Z \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, and let $ ilde{X}, ilde{Y}, ilde{Z}$ be smooth extensions of them to an open subset of $\mathbb {R}^n$ or $\mathbb {R}^{r,s}$. At points of $M$, we have

egin{align*} abla ^{ op }_X \langle Y, Z angle & = X \langle Y, Z angle = ilde{X} \langle ilde{Y}, ilde{Z} angle \ & = \overline{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} \langle ilde{Y}, ilde{Z} angle \ & = \langle \overline{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Y}, ilde{Z} angle + \langle ilde{Y}, \overline{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Z} angle \ & = \langle \pi ^{ op } (\overline{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Y}), ilde{Z} angle + \langle ilde{Y}, \pi ^{ op } (\overline{ abla }_{ ilde{X}} ilde{Z}) angle \ & = \langle abla ^{ op }_X Y, Z angle + \langle Y, abla ^{ op }_X Z angle , \end{align*}

where the next-to-last equality follows from the fact that $ ilde{Z}$ and $ ilde{Y}$ are tangent to $M$.
